notes.title: Update V0.3.1
notes.notes:
v0.3.1

• [b]New Game mode - Target mode. [/b]
   [i]Includes 20 sub-puzzles, where the goal of each puzzle is to clear all the special blocks.[/i]
• Optimized the jittering issue on the rhythm indicator caused by rotating the ghost piece.
• Optimized the editor
   [i]Preferences will be automatically saved when entering level testing, the UI interface will automatically turn off the music and block keyboard operations.[/i]
• Adjusted the score system and score display.
• UI adjustments.

notes.title: [Closed] Game test Invitation
notes.notes:
After a period of hard work, it's time to get valuable feedback from players. So if you want to test the game, Join https://discord.gg/tfwssAeQTb and pm me.

who likes to play Tetris-like game
